complexity_assessment.reasoning: Well-scoped task with clear acceptance criteria using established test harness patterns (80+ existing test suites in codebase provide templates). Work is mechanical but requires attention to edge cases, especially for tmux color codes and GitHub API mocking.

skill_rationale.testing-strategy: Essential across plan/design/review/compound_quality—this skill provides the test harness conventions (mock binaries, temp directories, PASS/FAIL counters, ERR traps) used by the existing 100+ test suites, which new tests must follow exactly.
skill_rationale.brainstorming: During planning, challenge assumptions about what edge cases and scenarios these 3 scripts require (e.g., invalid role names, missing panes, GitHub API failures, color code bounds).
skill_rationale.adversarial-quality: During design and review, think like a chaos engineer—identify failure modes in tmux color handling, pane ID validation, GitHub API mocking, and environment variable dependencies that tests must cover.
skill_rationale.pr-quality: Test suite PRs must be crystal clear—readers should instantly understand what each test case validates and how it follows the established harness pattern without having to read 10 other test files for context.

review_focus: Test completeness: Do test cases cover happy paths AND error paths for each script?
Pattern consistency: Do new test suites use identical structure to sw-tmux-test.sh (746 lines), sw-tracker-providers-test.sh (552 lines), and other reference implementations?

Edge case coverage: For sw-tmux-role-color.sh (color codes), test invalid/missing role inputs; for sw-tmux-status.sh (widgets), test missing panes/vars; for sw-tracker-github.sh (API), test GitHub API failures and rate limits.
Mock isolation: Verify tests don't make real GitHub API calls, don't modify actual tmux sessions, don't create persistent artifacts.
CI integration: Ensure all 3 new test suites are registered in package.json and run successfully in GitHub Actions (matching the pattern of existing test suites).
risk_areas: Tmux interaction mocking is fragile—tests need to verify shell invocation without actually running tmux (study sw-tmux-test.sh for the mock_tmux pattern).
GitHub API mocking must be robust—tracker-github tests need proper credential redaction and request/response mocking to avoid flaky tests (reference sw-tracker-providers-test.sh).
Coverage metrics must truly reach 100%—verify scripts/sw-* count includes only the 3 new test scripts (not utility files) and that CI reports 103/103.
Test maintenance burden—new tests must be deterministic and not flaky; flaky tests erode trust and will be disabled, defeating the coverage goal.
